title: CRaFT: An Explanation-Based Framework for Evaluating Cultural Reasoning in Multilingual Language Models
findings: The study found that large language models dynamically reconstruct their reasoning on culturally sensitive topics, including those influenced by religion such as family values, based on the linguistic context of the prompt. For instance, the models adopted more traditional, religion-aligned stances on family structures when prompted in Arabic compared to English. This demonstrates that cultural awareness, including the reflection of religious norms, is an emergent, language-contingent property rather than an intrinsic, stable trait of the models.
